result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. Nothing is committed.

- **HTML generated pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)`. The old `html|html` alternation was a typo that dropped `.htm`.
- **.NET doc XML:** the path pattern is now `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **`// Generated by` JavaScript:** the path pattern is now `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** the path pattern is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I checked the change with a temporary JUnit test against the real default lists, then deleted it. It confirmed that the new `.htm`, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js` and `build-gradle.js` cases match. It also confirmed that the old matches still hold (`.html` Doxygen, `.xhtml` generator meta, `build.gradle`). Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope. The existing `CodeConfigurationTest`, `SourceFileFilterTest` and `SourceFileTest` pass offline.

One note: a hand-written XML file that has `<doc>` within its first two lines will still be classified as generated. That is the rule as the task defines it, so I left it alone.
